t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Green Blue Orange & Yellow Gnomes take you to one forest/basket. TO get a high score you need to occasionally change between groups as their score will slowly reduce. Sometimes both groups will give low scores so you have to keep changing till you get a higher score.

vb_textbox.text: There are two groups of Gnomes. a) 'Green, Blue, Orange and Yellow' & 'Purple, Pink, Brown and Red.' Each of these groups can either be high value or low value. This seems to change randomly. When you find that one group is scoring high stick with it until it changes. Sometimes both groups will be scoring low and you just have to swap between the two groups until you notice a change.
